source: nfl_data_py: import_pbp_data (nflfastR) for incompletion counts, import_weekly_pfr('rec', ...) (Pro Football Reference charting) for drop counts
note: Flat population rate, not depth-conditioned - PFR's drop counts are weekly aggregates with no per-play air_yards to bucket against, and no ID crosswalk was used to join PFR's pfr_player_id to pbp's gsis-style ids.
